name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted web radio management suite with built-in AutoDJ, Icecast, Liquidsoap, MariaDB and a web dashboard for running stations.

alerts.message: The first account created in the setup wizard becomes the super administrator. Open the site right after deployment to claim it.

Listener streams are served through the web proxy under /listen/ on the main domain. Direct station ports and SFTP are not exposed, so external source clients (such as a desktop broadcasting tool) cannot connect; use the built-in Web DJ instead.
